title: Cell Biology by the Numbers
result: Textbook, online edition read 2026-10-21 at book.bionumbers.org, vignette 'What is the free energy released upon combustion of sugar?'. The free energy released in oxidising glucose by oxygen is about -3000 kJ/mol (about -700 kcal/mol). Glycolysis, the TCA cycle and the electron transfer chain couple the combustion of one glucose molecule to the production of roughly 30 ATP molecules (BNID 101778).
